text:
sam: quick idea: tiny tool 'pinforge' to generate deploy-bot commands + release-note stub + rollback one-liner. default dry-run.

ivy: yes please. core features?

sam: 1) validate pin compatibility; 2) check change-window collisions; 3) output brief+full formats; 4) optional PR creation for release notes.

deploy-bot: simulated: dry-run ok for payments@v2026.06.01-rc2

lee: permissions: tool should never execute by default, require --execute + release-gate check, and log to audit.

ops-sre: also include timezone normalization and suggest canary presets (5/25/100). warn on overlapping high-risk windows.

ivy: can it auto-fill migration notes from repo CHANGELOG entries? even a best-effort would cut copy/paste.

sam: MVP: look for recent changelog lines and attach as suggestions, user edits before PR.

lee: add an escape-hatch rollback template that formats a Slack blurb + grafana queries.

sam: timeline: prototype this week, demo in next release sync.

ivy: will help with PR flow. thanks!
